label: update gate: last two copy-phase outputs (end of copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L); zero activity in the original and delimiter phases and never on the first copy step (recall_idx 0) or on first occurrences of a token. Activity concentrates on the final outputs: to_go=0 holds 58% of mass and to_go=1 holds 29%, decaying to zero by to_go>=6. The largest activations are at the last step of short (L=3) sequences, e.g. c u z <DEL> c [u]. Only ~26% of last-two copy steps fire, though. Whether it fires depends diffusely on token identity (inputs b, r, e, g, u are favored; out_tok z, e, c too), and L=5 sequences fire rarely. A token-list refinement trades recall for precision and does not raise F1 much, so it is not included.
